output_layout_note: Raw one-to-many YOLO26-seg head. Detection feature dim = 4 (box) + num_classes + 32 (mask coefficients); here 4 + 10 + 32 = 46, over 8400 anchors. Per-run model-metadata.json carries the real output_shape from the trained class count (e.g. 2 classes -> [1, 38, 8400], 5 classes -> [1, 41, 8400]). onnx2tf/litert may transpose tensors at runtime ([1,46,8400] <-> [1,8400,46]; protos [1,32,160,160] <-> [1,160,160,32]); the app detects orientation. NMS + mask assembly run on-device. The app MUST read the class-column count from class_names.length (metadata), never a hardcoded value.
